subject.title: Feature request: Local plugin scanner CLI for pre-publish validation

question: Should ClawHub stop at `clawhub package validate` as the supported pre-publish feedback path, or sponsor a first-class local plugin scanner with ClawScan/security parity?
rationale: The remaining work affects the public CLI contract and security semantics, including what scanner evidence is safe to expose before publish and how closely local results must match hosted scans.

options.title: Keep current validator
options.body: Document `clawhub package validate` and publish dry-run as the supported pre-publish path while keeping hosted ClawScan tied to submitted artifacts.

options.title: Define scanner parity
options.body: Approve a supported local scanner/linter command with explicit scope, redaction, severity, exit-code, and JSON compatibility rules before implementation.

options.title: Split narrower gaps
options.body: Keep this issue as the scanner umbrella and open smaller follow-ups only for missing Plugin Inspector or manifest validation coverage.

recommendation.title: Define scanner parity
recommendation.body: Approve a supported local scanner/linter command with explicit scope, redaction, severity, exit-code, and JSON compatibility rules before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The most direct current code and merged PR history for the package CLI validation and local scan surfaces points to Patrick-Erichsen.
